# st-cloudflare_domain (Resource)

Register a domain through the Cloudflare Registrar. Registration goes through the Registrar Registrations API via the official cloudflare-go SDK; when the resource's `use_sandbox` attribute is set, it targets the Registrar Sandbox endpoints instead, which allow free test registrations (`.com`/`.net` only) without real domains or billing.

Requires the provider `api_token`; the `account_id` is set on the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "st-cloudflare_domain" "example_domain" {
  account_id     = "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
  domain         = "example.com"
  purchase_years = 1
  auto_renew     = true
  privacy        = true
}
```

The registrant contact is not part of the configuration: production registrations use the account's default address book contact (set once under Domain Registration → Registrant Contact in the Cloudflare dashboard) — if the account has none, apply fails with a hint to complete it. Sandbox registrations use a built-in placeholder contact automatically.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The Cloudflare account ID that owns the registration. Changing this registers the domain under a different account (forces replacement).
- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Whether the domain is automatically renewed before expiration. Setting `true` authorizes Cloudflare to charge the account's default payment method up to 30 days before expiry.
- `domain` (String) Domain name to register (FQDN, e.g. `example.com`).
- `privacy` (Boolean) WHOIS privacy: `true` requests redaction, `false` disables it. Cannot be changed after registration.

### Optional

- `purchase_years` (Number) Registration term in years (1-10). Defaults to the registry's minimum period (1 year for most extensions). Cannot be changed after registration.
- `min_days_remaining` (Number) Renewal window threshold in days: `required_renew` becomes `true` when the domain expires within this many days. Defaults to `0` (only expired domains are flagged).
- `use_sandbox` (Boolean) Register through the Registrar Sandbox endpoints instead of the production Registrar: free test registrations (`.com`/`.net` only), no billing, no real domains. Defaults to `false`. Changing it forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `domain_expiry_date` (String) The expiry date of the domain in ISO 8601 format (e.g. `2027-01-15T10:00:00Z`). Computed automatically from the registration.
- `status` (String) Registration status, e.g. `active`, `expired`, `suspended`.
- `required_renew` (Boolean) A boolean flag to keep track of whether domain renewal action is required.

## Notes

- **Idempotency**: Cloudflare permits one registration per domain, so `terraform apply` on a domain that is already registered (e.g. after an earlier apply timed out but completed server-side) adopts the existing registration into state instead of attempting a second purchase.
- **Updates**: the Cloudflare Registrar API supports updating `auto_renew` only. Changing `purchase_years` or `privacy` after creation produces an explicit error.
- **Delete**: domain registrations cannot be deleted in Cloudflare. `terraform destroy` disables `auto_renew` (so the registration lapses at the end of its term instead of renewing) and removes the resource from state; the domain itself stays registered.
- **Sandbox**: `use_sandbox = true` registers against `/registrar-sandbox/` — no billing, no real domains, `.com`/`.net` only, and sandbox purchases are persisted (a name bought there is not re-buyable in the sandbox). The sandbox also rejects re-enabling `auto_renew` once it has been disabled (no billing), so a `auto_renew = true` config cannot converge on an already-disabled sandbox registration; production accounts are unaffected. The `st-cloudflare_zone_type` resource is unaffected: zone operations always run against the production Cloudflare API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Production registration:
terraform import st-cloudflare_domain.example_domain <account_id>/<domain>

# Registrar Sandbox registration:
terraform import st-cloudflare_domain.example_domain sandbox/<account_id>/<domain>
```

The account ID is needed to locate the registration; sandbox registrations require the `sandbox/` prefix because they live under the Registrar Sandbox endpoints. `purchase_years` cannot be recovered from the API, so after an import it is adopted from the configuration on the next apply; changing it on an already-managed resource is still rejected.
